title: Eyes of Fate
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the temporal-spatial rift, he found Tianqing Sect's Sect Gate shrouded in black cloth—and in the distance, the Xuanwu Sect's banner was slowly rising through the morning mist.

text.content:
Deep within the Void, Chen Ji floated in boundless darkness.

He had no breath, no heartbeat, yet he could clearly perceive every fluctuation of this realm. This was the crevice of fate, the temporal-spatial rift he had torn open using the Tianji Record Fragment—and now, he finally stood at a height he had never dared imagine for eighteen years.

The very center of the chessboard.

"So that's how it is." He murmured to himself, his voice echoing through the void, "Chen Xuan sent me here not to inherit the Tianji Record. But to make me a variable from the very beginning."

He slowly closed his eyes, his mind rapidly retracing all the clues from this sequence of experiences.

From the moment he learned he possessed Chen family bloodline, everything began to connect.

Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect because her "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" constitution could disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight; Ling Yuan's hatred for Chen Xuan stemmed from once being the chosen inheritor only to be ultimately abandoned; and the Xuanwu Sect's expansion, Han Lie's步步紧逼, were merely clearing obstacles for the true chess player.

He had always believed he was the one laying out the world.

Until this moment, he finally understood—he himself was the most critical piece on this chessboard.

"Interesting." Chen Ji opened his eyes, a self-mocking curve forming at the corner of his mouth, "Eighteen years as waste, turns out I was making way for the chessboard."

dialogue.content:
Just then, an eye opened in the depths of darkness.

That eye had no eyelids, no pupils, only a chaotic gray-white expanse—but the moment it gazed upon Chen Ji, the latter felt a pressure sufficient to crush souls.

【You have finally arrived.】

The voice did not come through his ears, but exploded directly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, causing blood to seep from all his orifices.

【Chen family's orphan, inheritor of the Tianji Record, Chen Xuan's final variable left for this world... I have waited a long time for you.】

text.content:
Chen Ji wiped away the blood at the corner of his eye, his expression反而平静下来.

He could sense the power contained within that eye—it was not a realm any cultivator could reach, but an existence that transcended the laws of heaven and earth. The so-called Eye of Heavenly Providence was probably not even a fraction of its true form's divine sense.

But he felt no fear.

Eighteen years of being a废物 taught him one thing: the more powerful an existence, the less likely it would casually strike at ants. Because that would dirty its eyes.

"Waiting for me?" He laughed lightly, "I thought you came to erase me."

That chaotic eye slightly narrowed, as if examining an interesting artifact.

dialogue.content:
【Erase?】

That eye let out a low laugh, like ancient thunder rolling through the void.

【Who do you think you are, worthy of my personal出手?】

Its voice carried undisguised contempt.

【Seventy-three prophets have died in the fate I arranged throughout the ages. Each of them once believed they could break the cycle, but in the end, they all became nourishment for the chessboard.】

【And you...】

That eye slowly turned toward Chen Ji, and within the chaotic gray-white, a hint of amusement seemed to emerge.

【You are the seventy-fourth. But also the only one who has given me a sense of surprise.】

text.content:
"Surprise?" Chen Ji raised an eyebrow, "Surprised that such a废物 piece survived until now? Or surprised that I dared tear open this curtain and meet you face to face?"

He did not retreat, but instead took a step forward.

Heavenly Fate Value疯狂跳动 in his Mental Sea, draining away with each passing second—but Chen Ji felt unprecedentedly清醒 at this moment. Eighteen years of restraint, scheming, and laying plans all converged into one一股底气.

He did not come to die.

He came to negotiate.

"I think," he stared directly at that chaotic eye, his voice平静得像是在讨论天气, "that you specifically let me see these, not to appreciate my fear. Say it directly—what do you want?"

choice.prompt: After the Eye of Heavenly Providence remained silent for a moment, it offered three choices—and Chen Ji had to make his decision within the framework it provided. But did it really have to be only these three options?

choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information about the essence of heaven

text.content:
【Bold.】

A hint of interest appeared in the Eye of Heavenly Providence's voice.

【Since you wish to know, I shall tell you—I am not your enemy. The true chess player is someone else.】

dialogue.content:
【I am merely a piece in its hand, just as you are, just as all previous prophets were.】

That chaotic eye slowly closed, then slowly opened.

【But you are the only one qualified to overturn the chessboard. That is why I let you see these.】

choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to directly obtain information
choices.visible_reward: Retain Heavenly Fate Value, buying space for future arrangements

text.content:
Chen Ji收敛气息, stepped back half a pace, putting on a demeanor of恭顺.

The Eye of Heavenly Providence looked at him,沉默了片刻.

【Interesting.】

Its voice betrayed no pleasure or anger.

【You are more skilled at balancing取舍 than I anticipated. But this chess game... the time remaining for you, is running out.】

choices.description: Do not engage with the Eye of Heavenly Providence, directly追溯 the traces of that "more ancient force." It says it is a piece—so who is the chess player?
choices.visible_reward: Discovered a clue leading to the truth

text.content:
Chen Ji did not respond to the words of the Heavenly Eye, but suddenly closed his eyes and probed his divine sense into the deepest part of the Tianji Record.

There, he sensed a faint thread - it was not a thread of fate, but something far more ancient.

【You...】 For the first time, the Heavenly Eye's voice fluctuated.

At that moment, a strange fluctuation came from the depths of the Void.

This fluctuation had nothing to do with the Heavenly Eye - it came from a more distant place, as if someone had cast a stone into the endless river of time.

Chen Ji followed the direction of that fluctuation and glimpsed a blurry figure.

The figure stood at the end of the spacetime rift, surrounded by the exact same light as the Tianji Record in his hand - but that light was more complete, more brilliant, as if it were the origin of this fragmentary corner.

"Chen Nian?!"

dialogue.content:
【You found her.】

The Heavenly Eye's voice carried an indecipherable emotion.

【The Chen twins - one is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the other is the Tianji inheritor. You were bound together from birth, together forming the most core variable in this chess game.】

The chaotic eye slowly turned toward Chen Ji.

【She is your weakness, but also your only chance. However, to awaken her, you need to pay a price -】

【Chapter Seven Hundred. I await you to break it yourself.】

As the words fell, the Heavenly Eye began to dissipate, and the spacetime rift slowly closed.

text.content:
Chen Ji stood in place, watching the chaotic eye completely disappear.

His heart finally began to race.

Eighteen years. A full eighteen years, he thought he was fighting alone, thought he was the loneliest piece in this chess game. But now he knew - Chen Nian had always been there, waiting for him at the end of time and space.

That missing sister, the girl taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key"... she not only survived, but was participating in this game in her own way.

"Good, very good."

Chen Ji laughed quietly, his laughter echoing in the Void, carrying a hint of madness, but also a hint of relief.

Since the chessboard has been laid bare, there is nothing to fear.

At the end of the spacetime rift, that blurry figure seemed to sense Chen Ji's gaze.

She slowly raised her hand and drew a rune in the Void - the rune was identical to the patterns on the Tianji Record, yet entirely different. It was not meant for foresight, but for connection.

Chen Ji felt his Tianji Record Fragment violently tremble, and a warm force surged into his Mental Sea through that rune. It was his sister - Chen Nian, telling him in her own way:

"I'm waiting for you."

"I will find you."

Tears glistened in Chen Ji's eyes, but he quickly suppressed them. Now was not the time for sentimentality.

He had already seen the entire chess game.

choice.prompt: The spacetime rift is about to close, the Heavenly Eye's words still echoing in his ears. Chen Ji must make the final decision before the rift closes -

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth and channeled all his divine sense, rushing toward the depths of the rift.

A violent vertigo struck him, his soul feeling torn apart - but the moment he was about to reach his limit, a warm hand held him.

"Brother, I found you."

That voice was crystal clear, like heavenly music.

choices.description: Now is not the time to take risks. Remember Chen Nian's transmitted information, return to the real world, and plan carefully.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, retaining capital for future plans
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's position may change again

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew his divine sense, allowing that warm force to leave its mark in his Mental Sea.

He knew Chen Nian was waiting for him, and he knew he had to become stronger to save her.

"Wait for me." He silently recited in his heart, then let the spacetime rift transport him back to the real world.

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Eye said "someone else is involved," follow this clue to trace and find the real mastermind behind the scenes.
choices.visible_reward: Discover key intelligence about the forces behind the scenes

text.content:
Chen Ji did not leave in a hurry; instead, he carefully sensed that ancient power at the edge of the rift.

He discovered some clues—At the end of the threads of fate, there seemed to be some existence gazing at him. But that gaze was too distant, too blurred, and he could not see its true form.

"Someday, I will drag you out." Chen Ji said coldly.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he had already returned to the secret chamber in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

Silence surrounded him, with only candlelight swaying gently. But his state of mind was entirely different from before he entered the temporal rift.

He knew his mission now.

He knew his weakness now.

He also knew that the true enemy was far more terrifying than he had imagined.

But none of this could make him retreat.

Because he finally understood one thing—the so-called waste, the so-called trash, had never been his shackles. That was the best protective coloration for his eighteen years, the greatest reliance that allowed him to grow quietly under the watchful eyes of various powers.

dialogue.content:
"Chapter 700, is it?"

Chen Ji stood up and pushed open the door of the secret chamber. Outside, it was already dawn, the first rays of the morning sun piercing through the clouds.

He gazed at that golden sky, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips.

"Fine. Then let me show you—"

His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable firmness.

"In Chapter 700, how I personally flipped this chessboard."

text.content:
However, at that moment, an urgent bell rang from the direction of the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate.

That was the alarm bell that would only sound when the sect faced enemy invasion—three short rings followed by one long, meaning the highest level of alert.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, looking toward where the sound came from. In the distant morning mist, he seemed to see countless banners fluttering. And the color of those banners was the unique dark black of the Xuanwu Sect.

Han Lie, you really couldn't wait.

He straightened his clothes, put back on the mask of cowardice and servility, and walked toward the sect gate. But deep within his Mental Sea, that warm imprint from Chen Nian was pulsing gently—

That was hope, and also his new trump card.

In Chapter 700, he would let everyone know what a true waste's reverse rise looked like.
